q: The Schur decomposition states that any matrix A ∈ Mₙ(ℂ) is unitarily similar to an upper triangular matrix:
opts: A = QTQ* with Q unitary and T upper triangular (Schur form)
A = LU with L lower triangular
exp: Schur decomposition: every complex matrix A is unitarily similar to an upper triangular T (Schur form): A = QTQ*. The diagonal of T gives the eigenvalues (in any order). Unlike eigendecomposition, Schur form always exists. It is the basis for the QR algorithm for eigenvalue computation.
